ModMetaData.name: Stranded
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Adds one quest, "Stranded".
A neighbouring settlement's transport breaks up over your land and drops a survivor on your map. Their people will come for them in six to ten days. Shelter the survivor until then and the settlement pays a finder's fee and remembers it.
The survivor is a whole person, alone, with no faction to protect them — so the quest is really an offer of a colonist you did not have to recruit. Take them and the settlement finds out. That costs goodwill, and goodwill is what buys you the next few weeks of quiet.
Everything here is XML built on vanilla quest nodes. There is no assembly, and no DLC is required — Royalty and Ideology files are cited in the def's header only as provenance for a node's shape, never as a dependency.
